armySpecialRules.name: THE GENERALS OF UNDEATH
armySpecialRules.description: If your army contains any Undead units, you must include at least one character that is a Wizard that uses the Lore of Necromancy.

armySpecialRules.name: Slain General
armySpecialRules.description:
At the end of the phase in which the General is removed as a casualty, and at the start of every friendly turn thereafter, all friendly Undead units on the battlefield must take a Leadership test. If the test is failed, the unit immediately suffers a number of Wounds equal to the amount by which it failed the Leadership test, with no saves of any kind allowed. These Wounds are distributed as if from a shooting attack.
If, at the start of any of your turns following the death of the General, there is one or more friendly Wizard Characters on the table who know spells from the Lore of Necromancy, no unit in the army needs to take this Leadership test while at least one of them remain.

armySpecialRules.name: Battle Standards
armySpecialRules.description: In addition to the normal rules for the army Battle Standard, units of Undead within 12" of their Battle Standard suffer D3 Wounds less than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule, or following the death of the Army General.

armySpecialRules.name: Characters and Units
armySpecialRules.description: Characters who are not Undead may join Undead units despite not being Unstable themselves. Mounted Characters ignore the Undead special rule of the mount. If an Undead unit would get destroyed as a result of Unstable, any remaining character(s) will need to take a Break test as normal the same phase, using the Leadership modifier that they lost the combat by.

armySpecialRules.name: THE RED THIRST
armySpecialRules.description: Roll a D6 at the end of each Close Combat phase in which one or more models was slain by a Vampire with this special rule. On a 5+, the Vampire recovers a single Wound, up to their starting value (excluding additional Wounds from mounts). This does not work against Animated Constructs, Daemons, Forest Spirits or Vampires.

armySpecialRules.name: UNDEAD
armySpecialRules.description: All models with the Undead special rule have the Animated Construct, Fear, and Unstable special rules. In addition, they ignore the Independent special rule. However, they may make march moves if they are within the Army General's Inspiring Presence range or are joined by a character with the Lore of Necromancy.

armySpecialRules.name: VAMPIRIC
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Vampiric special rule have the Fear and Immunity (Psychology) special rules. In addition, models suffer a -1 penalty To Wound rolls against them, unless they are using Magical Attacks or Flaming Attacks. However, Vampiric models treat all rivers as Deadly Terrain unless they are mounted.

armySpecialRules.name: WATERLOGGED WEAPONS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule must roll a D6 for every To Hit roll of 1 with missile weapons that they make. On a 1-3, resolve the Hit against the model itself. Artillery weapons deduct 1 from the result rolled on the Blackpowder Misfire Chart.

armySpecialRules.name: SWIVEL GUN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
18/36" | 6 | Multiple Wounds (D3), Ponderous

armySpecialRules.name: VOLLEY GUN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12/24" | 5 | Multiple Shots (D6), Ponderous, Rapid Fire

magicItems.name: STAR-METAL HARPOON
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Heroic Killing Blow special rule. Additionally, they may reroll failed To Wound rolls against models with the Aquatic special rule.

magicItems.name: THE BLOODY NORA
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains D3+2 Extra Attacks on any turn they charge, and gives them +2 Extra Attacks in subsequent rounds.

magicItems.name: LUCKY LEVI'S HOOK HAND
magicItems.description: All attacks with this hook are made at +2 Strength.

magicItems.name: SLOPPY CRUICKSHANK'S LONG-LOST CUTLASS
magicItems.description: The first attack directed towards the wielder in each round of Close Combat automatically misses. In addition, they gain +1 to Hit and the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: KRAKEN FANG
magicItems.description: The Kraken Fang gives the wielder the Ice Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: DIRTY SERPENT
magicItems.description: The Dirty Serpent gives the wielder +1 Strength and the Armour Piercing (3) special rule.

magicItems.name: PRESS-GANGER'S CUTLASS
magicItems.description: If the wielder is in a unit of Undead Infantry, for each model they slay in close combat, an extra model is added to the unit, just like a summoning spell.

magicItems.name: POSSESSED PISTOL
magicItems.description: Shots from this weapon ignore penalties for cover. Additionally, the wielder can shoot at units in close combat as if the target were outside of combat, even when the wielder is in close combat. Normal rules for Line of Sight still apply.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE DEPTHS
magicItems.description: The Armour of the Depths gives the wearer the Regeneration (5+) special rule, and enemies attempting to strike them suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: BLOODY BILL'S BUCKLER
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Parry (6+) special rule, and any enemy attempting to strike him in Close Combat suffers -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: HULL-FUSED ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer has a 3+ armour save that cannot be improved by any means, and may reroll failed armour saves. However, they also have the Flammable special rule.

magicItems.name: CRUSTACEAN ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The bearer has the Natural Armour save (5+) and the Unbearable Stench special rule (see Rotting Leviathans).

magicItems.name: SEA DRAGON BUCKLER
magicItems.description: The Sea Dragon Buckler gives the wearer a 5+ armour save against missile attacks and the Magical Ward (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: CORAL-GROWTH HELMET
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains the Natural Armour (6+) special rule. In addition, their armour save can never be reduced to less than 6+.

magicItems.name: PANTELEON'S PENDANT
magicItems.description: The wearer has the Regeneration (6+) special rule. Additionally, if the bearer is killed by a spell, missile or close combat attack, they may take a Leadership test on their own unmodified value. If passed, the model is brought back to life with one Wound remaining.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF EVANESCENSE
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Ethereal special rule. However, it may not join non-Ethereal units or take any weapons or armour.

magicItems.name: RING OF SEA MIST
magicItems.description: Enemies suffer -1 To Hit with missile weapons against the bearer and any unit they are with. In addition, all enemy models that charges into base contact with the bearer or their unit must take a Dangerous Terrain test.

magicItems.name: THE RING OF UNDEATH
magicItems.description: The model wearing this item automatically regains one Wound suffered earlier during the game at the start of each of your turns.

magicItems.name: EX-PARROT
magicItems.description: The Ex-Parrot gives the model the Magic Resistance (1) and Magical Ward (6+) special rules.

magicItems.name: CURSED BULLION OF BOGENHAFEN
magicItems.description: This item contains the Burning Head spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: THE EBONY SKULLS
magicItems.description: This item contains the Raise Dead spell from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: SPELL OF THE NECROMANCER'S APPRENTICE
magicItems.description: This item contains the Deathly Cabal spell from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: LUCKY LEVI'S KEEPSAKE
magicItems.description: The bearer may re-roll the number of models gained when casting summoning spells from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: DOUBLOON OF CASTELO NOVO
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer of this item at the start of each Close Combat phase suffers 2D6 Strength 3 Hits.

magicItems.name: GENTLEMAN JENKIN'S TRUSTY COMPASS
magicItems.description: The character and one unit of your choice that they may join, may deploy as Scouts. In addition, they may re-roll all failed rolls to Reform during the Battle.

magicItems.name: PEARL OF THE KRAKEN SEA
magicItems.description: All Undead models in a unit joined by the bearer of this item gain the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: DEAD MAN'S CHEST
magicItems.description: All Undead models in a unit joined by the bearer of this item gain +1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: MAD MULLET'S SPYIN' GLASS
magicItems.description: This item gives the model the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: VORGO NUGGET
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Immunity (Ice Attacks) special rule. In addition, they gain +2 to their rolls for The Red Thirst. If the bearer has killed one or more models that round of close combat and the enemy unit Breaks, they must pass a Leadership test in order to pursue the enemy; if failed, they may not pursue.

magicItems.name: JELLYFISH IN A JAR
magicItems.description: The bearer’s close combat attacks automatically Wound on To Hit rolls of 6.

magicItems.name: BLOODY REAVER COLOURS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard has a Magical Ward (5+) against missile attacks and the Vanguard special rule.

magicItems.name: SKULL AND CROSSBONES
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Terror and Vanguard special rules.

magicItems.name: BLOODIED BANNER OF SLAYERS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE SPITEFUL SHOT
magicItems.description: All Zombies in the unit carrying this standard ignores all To Hit modifiers.

magicItems.name: WAR STANDARD O' THE CORPSE SURGEONS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: FLAG OF ETERNAL SERVICE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard suffers half the number of wounds they normally would due to the Unstable special rule or following the death of the Army General.

magicItems.name: SINISTER FIGUREHEAD
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit in base contact with the unit carrying this standard must re-roll successful Leadership tests. This has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF NECROMANCY
loresOfMagic.attribute: When a spell from the Lore of Necromancy is successfully cast, all Undead units (excluding mounts) within 6" of the caster regain 1 Wound (Core Units regain D3 Wounds) following the rules for Invocation of Nehek.

spells.name: INVOCATION OF NEHEK
spells.description: Invocation of Nehek is a summoning spell with a range of 18" that targets Undead (excluding mounts). The target immediately regains a number of Wounds as follows: Core Units gain 2D6 Wounds; Special Units (except Cavalry) gain D6 Wounds. Characters, Special Units that are Cavalry and Rare Units regain D3 Wounds per successful casting. Models gained are distributed as a summoning spell. Any characters in a unit can only be healed if targeted separately from the rest of the unit, in which case only they are healed.

spells.name: HAND OF DUST
spells.description: Remains in play. Hand of Dust is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. While the spell is in effect, the caster gains an additional special attack in close combat that does not benefit from any other magic items or special rule. If this Attack Hits, the target suffers an automatic Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple Wounds (D6) special rules.

spells.name: VANHEL'S DANSE MACABRE
spells.description: Vanhel's Danse Macabre is a conveyance spell with a range of 24" that targets Undead (including mounts). The target can immediately make a normal move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase (including any Characters in the unit).

spells.name: HELLISH VIGOUR
spells.description: Hellish Vigour is an augment spell with a range of 18". All Undead models (including mounts) in the unit gain the Always Strikes First special rule and may re-roll failed To Hit rolls in Close Combat until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: FOUNTAINS OF BLOOD
spells.description: Fountains of Blood is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all failed To Wound rolls made against this unit may be re-rolled. In addition, Vampires gain a +1 to bonus to any The Red Thirst rolls for Wounds caused against this unit.

spells.name: DEATHLY CABAL
spells.description: Deathly Cabal is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, the target gains the Fear and Magical Ward (6+) special rules.

spells.name: GAZE OF NAGASH
spells.description: Gaze of Nagash is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 4 hits.

spells.name: RAISE DEAD
spells.description: Raise Dead is a summoning spell with a range of 18" that brings a unit of Zombies into play. Roll 2D6+3. This is how many models comprise the new unit. The caster can choose to summon 2D6+3 Skeleton Warriors with shields instead. If they do so, the casting value is increased to 12+.

spells.name: UNQUIET SPIRITS
spells.description: Unquiet Spirits is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". The target suffers 3D6 Strength 2 hits with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: MALEDICTION OF NAGASH
spells.description: Malediction of Nagash is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target halves their Strength (rounding down) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SPIRITUAL VORTEX
spells.description: Remains in play. Spiritual Vortex is a summoning spell with a range of 24" that summons the 5" template, which may be placed over an enemy unit. While the spell is in effect, the template counts as Dangerous Terrain, and enemy units within 6" of it suffer -1 to their Leadership.

spells.name: CURSE OF YEARS
spells.description: Remains in Play. Curse of Years is a hex spell with a range of 18". When cast, roll a D6 for every model in the target unit – on a score of 6 the model suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. At the end of the next Magic phase, roll again for each model in the unit, they will suffer a Wound on a 5+, and so on, to a maximum of 2+.

spells.name: WIND OF UNDEATH
spells.description: Wind of Undeath is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 12". Each unit within range suffer 2D6 Strength 3 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF THE DEEP
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a spell from the Lore of the Deep is cast on an enemy unit, that unit also suffers D6 Strength 1 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves in addition to the effects of the spell.

spells.name: TIDECALL
spells.description: Tidecall is a direct damage spell. The caster makes a Strength 2 Breath Weapon Attack with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. This may be cast in close combat, following the normal rules for Breath Weapons.

spells.name: BLOOD IN THE WATER
spells.description: Blood in the Water is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all models in the target unit gets to immediately make an additional Attack for every unsaved Wound they cause in Close Combat. These Attacks can generate additional Attacks to a maximum of +2 Attacks per attacking model in the unit.

spells.name: COUNTER-CURRENT
spells.description: Remains in play. Counter-Current is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target halves all its movement (rounding up) while moving closer to the caster and while being within their front arc.

spells.name: FOG OF THE DAMNED
spells.description: Remains in Play. Fog of the Damned is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target cannot gain combat resolution bonuses from Ranks or Outnumber.

spells.name: PRESSURE OF THE DEEP
spells.description: Pressure of the Deep is a direct damage spell with a range of 12" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target must take D6 Toughness tests. Each failed Toughness test causes a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: ABYSSAL DARKNESS
spells.description: Abyssal Darkness is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase all missile attacks targeted at the Wizard and any unit they are with suffer a -1 To Hit penalty, and enemies need to be within 18" to be able to draw Line of Sight to them.

spells.name: GAZE INTO THE ABYSS
spells.description: Gaze Into the Abyss is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit suffers -1 Weapon Skill, -1 Initiative and -2 Leadership until the start of the caster's next Magic Phase.

spells.name: STEED OF TIDES
spells.description: Steed of Tides is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". The target is immediately picked up and may be moved to any position on the battlefield within 3D6" of their original position (or within any water terrain feature on the battlefield), just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: WATERY GRAVE
spells.description: Watery Grave is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit counts as moving through dangerous terrain until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. For every 4" the unit moves while the spell is in effect, the chance of them failing the test increases by +1.

spells.name: ARCANE CORRASION
spells.description: Arcane Corrasion is a magic missile that causes a number of Strength 4 Hits depending on the distance to the target. If the target is within less than 12" it suffers D6 Hits. If the target is within 12" to 24" it suffers 2D6 Hits. If the target is within 24" to 36" it suffers 3D6 Hits.

spells.name: DENIZENS OF THE DEEP
spells.description: Denizens of the Deep is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that causes 6D6 Strength 2 Hits.

spells.name: KRAKEN'S PULL
spells.description: Remains in Play. Kraken's Pull is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template must pass a Strength test or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: VORPAL MAELSTROM
spells.description: Vorpal Maelstrom is a direct damage spell. Place the large template anywhere within 18" of the Wizard; it then scatters D6". All models under the template suffer a Strength Hit equal to their Unit Strength plus 2. In addition, any surviving models will have their Movement value lowered by half until the start of the caster's next Magic Phase.

vampiric_powers.name: RED FURY
vampiric_powers.description: For each unsaved Wound caused by the model in close combat, it can immediately make an additional Attack (to a maximum of +3 Attacks). These additional Attacks do not benefit from Red Fury.

vampiric_powers.name: UNHOLY REGENERATION
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: CURSE OF THE REVENANT
vampiric_powers.description: The model has a 3+ invulnerable save when they have a single Wound remaining (if the model suffers multiple Wounds in a single turn, it is reduced to 1 Wound and may then attempt to take this invulnerable save).

vampiric_powers.name: FOG OF DECEPTION
vampiric_powers.description: The Vampire and any unit they are in may re-deploy themselves wholly within 12" from their original location after all other units have been positioned, but before Scouts are placed on the table.

vampiric_powers.name: FEAR INCARNATE
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units in base contact with the model must pass a Leadership test at the start of each round of close combat or suffer -1 To Hit this round.

vampiric_powers.name: FLYING HORROR
vampiric_powers.description: Thе model gains the Fly (10) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: VOICES FROM THE DEEP
vampiric_powers.description: When casting spells from the Lore of the Deep, the model may add a +D3 casting bonus once per Magic phase.

vampiric_powers.name: FAR-REACHING WILL
vampiric_powers.description: The Vampire allows one unit of Zombie Deckhands to deploy as Ambushers.

vampiric_powers.name: SUPERNATURAL HORROR
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Terror special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: SWASHBUCKLER
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Parry (6+) special rule. Whenever the model rolls a natural 6 when taking a Parry save, it automatically inflicts an extra Hit back onto the model or unit that struck the blow.

vampiric_powers.name: TAUNTING CURSES
vampiric_powers.description: Whenever the Vampire successfully casts one or more spells on an enemy unit, that unit suffers -1 to their Leadership until the start of your next Magic phase. In addition, when the Vampire issues a challenge, nominate an enemy character in the same close combat. That model must pass a Leadership test or be forced to accept the challenge.

vampiric_powers.name: TRANSFIX
vampiric_powers.description: At the beginning of the Close Combat phase, select one model in base contact with the Vampire. The victim must pass a Leadership test or be unable to attack in that Close Combat phase and all attacks directed against the victim will hit automatically.

vampiric_powers.name: HORNSWAGGLE
vampiric_powers.description: At the beginning of the Close combat phase, roll a D6; on a 4+ the enemy unit will suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill until the beginning of the next Close combat phase.

vampiric_powers.name: STORMCALL
vampiric_powers.description: The Vampire gains the Storm of Cronos spell from the Lore of Heavens as a Bound Spell.

vampiric_powers.name: UNBENDING WILLPOWER
vampiric_powers.description: Units of Undead within 6" of one or more models with this power suffer one less Wound than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule or following the death of the army's General. Note that this is not cumulative with the Battle Standard.

vampiric_powers.name: WHARF RATS
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units in base contact with the Vampire suffer D6 Strength 1 Attacks with the Always Strikes Last and Poisoned Attacks special rules in each round of Close Combat.

vampiric_powers.name: CLOYING MISTS
vampiric_powers.description: Enemy models in base contact with the model are reduced to Initiative 1.

vampiric_powers.name: HONOUR OR DEATH
vampiric_powers.description: At the start of a challenge, the enemy character selected to take on the Vampire must take a Leadership test before any blows are struck. If failed, the enemy model will fight with Weapon Skill 1 for the remainder of the turn.
